mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.class_id, a.unit_id, a.created_by, a.deadline, a.created_time, c.name as class_name, u.name as unit_name, creator.real_name as creator_name, creator.nickname as creator_nickname FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN classes c ON a.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN units u ON a.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users creator ON a.created_by = creator.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) as total_students, COUNT(a.id) as total_assignments, 0 as completed_tasks FROM classes c LEFT JOIN assignments a ON c.id = a.class_id LEFT JOIN student_classes sc ON c.id = sc.class_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT c.id as id, c.name as name, c.description, co.name as courseName, c.created_time FROM classes c LEFT JOIN courses co ON c.course_id = co.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, c.name as class_name, a.deadline, creator.real_name as creator_name, creator.nickname as creator_nickname, a.created_time FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN classes c ON a.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users creator ON a.created_by = creator.id WHERE a.created_by = #{teacherId} ORDER BY a.created_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
